interval_definition: Empirical 2.5th to 97.5th percentile range across independent seeded replications; descriptive, not a population confidence interval.
pareto_definition: A policy is efficient within one shift and cost declaration when no benchmarked policy has both lower mean normalized expected cost and lower mean equalized-odds gap, with at least one strict improvement. This is benchmark-relative, not globally optimal.

policies.label: Cost-sensitive threshold
policies.selection: One global threshold minimizes declared error cost on source tuning data.

policies.label: Target recalibration
policies.selection: Temperature and global cost threshold are selected on an independent target adaptation sample.

policies.label: Reweighed training
policies.selection: Training weights balance group-label cells; a source cost threshold is then selected.

policies.label: Group thresholds · λ=0.1
policies.selection: Two source-tuned thresholds minimize normalized error cost plus λ times the equalized-odds gap.

policies.label: Group thresholds · λ=0.3
policies.selection: Two source-tuned thresholds minimize normalized error cost plus λ times the equalized-odds gap.
